WITH voluntary_closures AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_key, close_date
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.fct_account_closures`
  WHERE is_voluntary
    AND close_date >= DATE '2026-02-05'
),
calls_near_closure AS (
  SELECT c.site_id, c.customer_key
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.fct_calls` AS c
  JOIN voluntary_closures AS vc
    ON c.customer_key = vc.customer_key
   AND c.conversation_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(vc.close_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND vc.close_date
)
SELECT
  n.site_id,
  s.site_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT n.customer_key) AS closing_customers_called
FROM calls_near_closure AS n
LEFT JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.dim_cc_site` AS s
  ON n.site_id = s.site_id
GROUP BY n.site_id, s.site_name
ORDER BY closing_customers_called DESC
